# `attack` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "attack" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/attack/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Unique attack id, e.g. "forgotten-overhead-chop". Stable once shipped. |
| `schemaVersion` | `1` | `1` | AttackDef schema version, for future migrations. |
| `notes` | string | required | Where the numbers come from (bead, design intent), for owner review. |
| `kind` | `"melee"` \| `"projectile"` \| `"area"` \| `"grab"` \| `"special"` | required | How it reaches its target. |
| `move` | ref → move | required | The move it performs: windup (startup), active and recovery ticks, hit volume, damage template, parry/block flags, telegraph tick and cues. Must be an "attack" move. |
| `telegraph` | id | required | Telegraph cue id render and audio play when the windup reads (AttackTelegraph event), e.g. "guard-strike-windup"; placeholder cues can be swapped later. |
| `range` | object | required | Distance band to the target (centre to centre, metres) the attack is used from: the distance precondition, and what AI spacing (e11) aims for. |
| `range.min` | number ≥ 0 | required | Closest distance to the target it is used from, metres. |
| `range.max` | number ≥ 0 | required | Farthest distance to the target it is used from, metres; at least min. |
| `extraPackets` | list of object | `[]` | Damage packets applied per hit after the move’s own damage template (e.g. a separate poison packet); each goes through the damage model on its own. |
| `extraPackets[].amounts` | map of `"slash"` \| `"pierce"` \| `"blunt"` \| `"fire"` \| `"frost"` \| `"shock"` \| `"arcane"` \| `"poison"` → number ≥ 0 | required | Damage points per damage type (before resistances); unlisted types deal 0. |
| `extraPackets[].poiseDamage` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Poise damage in points. |
| `extraPackets[].staminaDamage` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Stamina drained from a blocker, in points (before shield stability). |
| `extraPackets[].impulse` | object | `{"x":0,"y":0,"z":0}` | Knockback impulse, N·s, in the attacker’s frame (+z forward, +y up). |
| `extraPackets[].impulse.x` | number | required |  |
| `extraPackets[].impulse.y` | number | required |  |
| `extraPackets[].impulse.z` | number | required |  |
| `extraPackets[].impactForce` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Peak impact force, N (breakables, knockdown). |
| `extraPackets[].tags` | list of id | `[]` | Damage-packet tags every hit carries, e.g. "critical" (damage model tags). |
| `cooldown` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Seconds after it starts before it may start again. |
| `weight` | number > 0 | `1` | Relative selection weight among usable attacks (AI, e11). |
| `preconditions` | object | `{}` | When the attack may be started, besides range and cooldown; evaluated deterministically by the sim (canStartAttack). |
| `preconditions.targetStances` | list of `"idle"` \| `"moving"` \| `"blocking"` \| `"attacking"` \| `"dodging"` \| `"staggered"` \| `"downed"` (at least 1) | — | Target stances it may be used against; absent = any. |
| `preconditions.health` | object | `{}` | Own health band (current / max health) it may be used in, e.g. a desperation move. |
| `preconditions.health.min` | number 0–1 | `0` | Lowest own health fraction, 0–1. |
| `preconditions.health.max` | number 0–1 | `1` | Highest own health fraction, 0–1; at least min. |
| `projectile` | object | — | Projectile flight (required for kind "projectile", forbidden otherwise). It launches on the first active tick from the move’s sphere hit volume, which is its size and launch point. |
| `projectile.speed` | number > 0 | required | Flight speed, metres per second (straight line). |
| `projectile.maxRange` | number > 0 | required | Distance after which it vanishes, metres. |
